_comment_proto_agg: Per-class reliability-aware prototype aggregation: r_ic = bn*norm(log(1+n)) - bs*sigma + bq*q - bd*drift - bu*update_norm. So hang quy mo duoc CHUAN HOA min-max theo size_term_mode (giong Q_i). Ban cu cong thang log1p(n): log1p(29.000.000)=17,18 vs log1p(365)=5,90, tau=1 => ti so trong so 79.235:1, tuc bon so hang do tin cay con lai (deu trong [0,1]) nam duoi nguong nhieu va phep gop thuc chat chi la lay prototype cua client nhieu mau nhat.

_comment_sua_hai_tang: SUA HAI TANG (tim ra tu log 03-09-26_17-21). Do la ly do loss phang o 1,7846 suot 13 vong roi task 1 lat tu acc 86,29 (f1_mac 20,98) xuong acc 0,92 (f1_mac 2,87) o vong 14 va khong bao gio hoi. calibrate_once_per_task=true -> prototype chi con dung de KHOI TAO dau task. calibrate_new_classes_only=true + bo `and not is_task_init` o trainer.py -> dau task chi ghi de trong so cac lop MOI, giu nguyen phan lop cu da hoc. Do la ly do prototype dau task 1 co cos(w_i,w_j)=0,9917. expand_feature_space=true -> doi phep hop nhat tu to hop loi sang NOI, feature_dim 64->128->192->256->320 (dung day so DER cua HFIN), nhanh plasticity doc du lieu THO thay vi 64 con so dau ra cua nhanh stability.
